m19.text: Fec, an old limping orc hunter, travels with Yasova Dragonclaw's party toward Ugin's grave, and he warns of an approaching dragon tempest so the party shelters in a rock chamber.
Walking point with Naiva, Fec tells her he was cast out by the Kolaghan for his limp, and they argue about the old ways.
Yasova sends him ahead to the cave, and from a hidden cleft the group watches Fec speak with a pregnant woman who claims an illness killed the camp.
In the end Yasova asks Tae Jin to stay and recite Ugin's story to Fec for carving.
